_comment: The wiki's time labels, materialised into concrete hour ranges.
These are the WIKI'S labels, not our canonical UI partition. They overlap —
'Day' (6am-8pm) fully contains 'Morning' (6am-11am) — so they are useless as
buckets and are only ever used as ranges to expand into a window's `time`.
The non-overlapping partition the UI uses lives in packages/schema
(TIME_BLOCK_RANGES) and is derived from `time`, never authored twice.
SOURCE for the hours: one Bugs row spells them out inline —
'Morning 6 AM - 11 AM / Day 6 AM - 8 PM' — which confirms the ranges given in
docs/research/01-game-data.md. Night at 8pm-2am matches the game day ending
'All day' means there is no time restriction. That is NOT the same as unknown:
it resolves to a null time with precision 'not_applicable', while an empty
cell resolves to null with precision 'unknown' plus a data gap. Ten of the 103
